shots.narration: モンゴル帝国――世界の半分を呑み込んだ最強の軍が、いま小国・大越に迫っていた。
shots.prompt: epic wide shot, vast Mongol cavalry horde silhouetted on the horizon under dark storm clouds, dust and war banners, ominous war drums atmosphere, slow forward camera push, cinematic scale

shots.dialogue: トアン: ……俺は、まだ何もできない。
shots.prompt: a burning village at dusk, villagers fleeing in panic, embers in the air, a 16-year-old boy standing frozen, fists clenched, frustration on his face, handheld dynamic camera, firelight

shots.dialogue: マイ: あなた……！ / トアン: 掴まれ、急げ！
shots.prompt: a girl trips as a burning wooden beam falls, the boy dashes in and shields her, brief intense eye contact, sparks and smoke, dramatic low angle, slow-motion accent

shots.dialogue: 衛兵: 若殿はお引き取りを。軍議は大人の場にござる。
shots.prompt: a grand medieval war council hall, lords and generals seated, the boy rushing to the entrance, two guards blocking him with crossed spears, formal tense atmosphere, warm lantern light

shots.dialogue: トアン: 俺だって戦える！ 国が燃えているんだぞ！
shots.prompt: the boy shouting in anger and frustration, pushed back as a heavy wooden door closes in front of him, tears of rage in his eyes, close-up to medium shot, dramatic shadow

shots.narration: 悔しさのあまり、彼は手の中のミカンを握り潰したことにすら、気づかなかった。
shots.prompt: extreme close-up of a trembling hand crushing an orange without noticing, juice dripping between fingers, then reveal the boy's furious distant eyes, symbolic dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field

shots.dialogue: マイ: その手……。 / トアン: ……見てろ。認められないなら、戦果で示すだけだ。
shots.prompt: the girl catches up and gasps seeing the crushed orange in the boy's hand, he looks down then up with newfound resolve burning in his eyes, intimate two-shot, soft rim light

shots.dialogue: トアン: 俺たちで、この国を守る！
shots.prompt: the boy raising a war banner with chinese characters, a crowd of young recruits cheering and raising fists behind him, low heroic angle, golden hour backlight, banners waving, epic uplifting

shots.caption: ――次回、初陣。
shots.prompt: over a ridge the Mongol vanguard cavalry suddenly appears charging with rising dust, the boy draws his curved sword facing them, tense cliffhanger, hard cut to black, dramatic
